entries.name: Representations from first principles
entries.description: A progression from one-hot and co-occurrence representations through PPMI-SVD, CBOW, Skip-Gram, GloVe, and FastText-style embeddings.

entries.name: Image architectures, assembled by hand
entries.description: Architecture-first image classifiers spanning LeNet-5, ZFNet, SqueezeNet, XNOR-Net, MobileNet, ShuffleNet, compression, MLP-Mixer, Xception, ResNet, DenseNet, CapsuleNet, and ViT.

entries.name: Sequence models and attention
entries.description: Vanilla RNN, LSTM, GRU, bidirectional and stacked recurrent models, plus encoder-decoder systems with attention, copying, and coverage mechanisms.

entries.name: Adversarial generation, one objective at a time
entries.description: An evolution from dense GANs through convolutional, least-squares, Wasserstein, gradient-penalty, conditional, translation, style, super-resolution, and progressive variants.

entries.name: Diffusion model study path
entries.description: A source and documentation path covering DDPM, Improved DDPM, DDIM, GLIDE, Imagen, DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion, ControlNet, and consistency models. Several dataset and training entrypoints are explicitly incomplete.

entries.name: Detectors from regions to grids
entries.description: Detector-specific pipelines covering R-CNN, Fast and Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, YOLOv1–v3, and SSD, with dataset adapters, custom heads, losses, training, inspection, and tests.

entries.name: Policy learning in small environments
entries.description: Monte-Carlo REINFORCE and policy-gradient agents use trajectory buffers, discounted returns, categorical policies, and GradientTape updates across classic-control environments.

entries.name: Vectorized DQN and Double DQN
entries.description: Batched environments, replay buffers, online and target Q-networks, compiled update paths, epsilon exploration, and Double-Q action selection/evaluation separation.

entries.name: Game agents with learning and search
entries.description: Game environments combine random, human, minimax, policy-gradient, actor-critic, DQN, Double DQN, and dueling-DQN agents, including canonical board observations and action masking.

entries.name: RedditStory language model
entries.description: A complete text pipeline with cleaning, quality scoring, BPE tokenization, TFRecords, a decoder-only Transformer, causal masking, evaluation, sampling, and runtime controls.

entries.name: Reinforcement-learning study implementations
entries.description: A study repository organized around dynamic programming, Monte Carlo, temporal-difference learning, and selected deep-RL implementations.

entries.name: JAX machine learning and RL practice
entries.description: A JAX practice repository covering classical machine learning, neural networks, CNN architectures, and reinforcement-learning experiments.
